title: Update creation output to show type and shortest unambiguous ID
description: Change creation output format from '✓ Created issue {short_id}' to 'Created {type} {shortest_unambiguous_id}'. Implement shortest_unambiguous_id(min_length: 3) function to find the minimum unique prefix for any issue ID. Update README to clarify ID notation and document minimum 3-character length. Update tests to verify new format.
